reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Automatic stream sharding is enabled by default: Automatic stream sharding helps keep the write load of high volume streams balanced across ingesters and helps…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Write load across ingesters will be automatically balanced using stream sharding by default, potentially redistributing traffic patterns across ingester instances.

proposed.statement: Automatic stream sharding is enabled by default in Loki 3.0.0 to balance write load across ingesters and avoid hot-spotting.
